hero.core.melodia.specialty.description:
{Lady Luck}

All creatures in Melodia's army receive {+1} Luck. {Ordinary Luck penalties} cannot reduce her army below {+1} Luck, but the {Misfortune} spell can still overcome this protection, and {effects that disable positive Luck} can suppress this bonus.
hero.core.melodia.specialty.name: Lady Luck
hero.core.melodia.specialty.tooltip: Melodia grants her army {+1} Luck and helps maintain at least {+1} Luck, unless stronger effects reduce it further.
